🎥🚔: Super Troopers 3 (2026)

Just when you thought these troopers couldn’t cause any more trouble, they’re back for their most ridiculous adventure yet. Farva is getting married to Thorny’s sister, turning what should be a simple celebration into absolute chaos as the rest of the crew gets dragged into the madness.

Things get even crazier when the troopers find themselves on the trail of a dangerous new drug operation. Between trying to crack the case and surviving Farva’s wedding plans, the team falls straight back into their old habits—pulling pranks, creating problems, and somehow making every situation more complicated than it needs to be.

Super Troopers 3 brings the Broken Lizard crew together again for another dose of wild police comedy, friendship, and pure mayhem.

In theatres August 7. Get tickets now at Searchlight Pictures.

source_details.synopsis: Super Troopers 3 (billed as Super Troopers 3: Farva’s Wedding, onscreen only) is a 2026 American comedy film directed by Jay Chandrasekhar. A sequel to the 2018 film Super Troopers 2, the film was written by and stars the Broken Lizard comedy team, made up of Chandrasekhar, Kevin Heffernan, Steve Lemme, Paul Soter and Erik Stolhanske. Super Troopers 3 was released in the United States by Searchlight Pictures on August 7, 2026, it received mixed reviews from critics.
